notes:
Shaped like a real export: no <?xml> header, CRLF line endings, entities in attributes, self-closing items, pageSource = base64(raw deflate(ASPX)). Expected items follow docs/INTERFACES.md "Project explorer": id = `${element}:${identity}` (EntityEndpoint: Name@Version; #2 for duplicates in document order), group from the classification table, status from the default view (CDATA bodies when present, else the element lines). `detail` null = unspecified by the contract or different per side. `lines` = text.split("
").length. Items are sorted by group order, then name. Line ranges are 1-based inclusive.
